ctx.x: I drank my bottle of cognac and the other one before we arrived in Paris in the morning of the 7th. The cognac had burned my throat to the point of my being so hoarse that I could hardly talk. I was taken to a hotel on Rue Henri Monnier which was in the heart of the Pigalle district. I had never heard of Pigalle but the day was beautiful and I was in Paris - not the one in Kentucky but the P A R I S. I was not sleepy although in a way I had walked from Monte

There was a bar downstairs in the hotel owned by Madame Liseux who was a beautiful amazon perhaps in her late 30s. I started to drink with some people in the bar and my voice was getting hoarser and hoarser. Finally someone persuaded me to go up to my room and get some rest, but it was 11 o'clock that night before I got to bed. I slept until 6 p.m. the next day and when I awakened, I had my voice back again.
